Entries.Introduction: Oh hey, you must be the new farmer. I'm Bentley. I run Bentley's Fast Food, so if you ever get hungry, you know where to find me.$1#$b#Fair warning: I don't do refunds on pickles.$5

Entries.Tue: Another day, another mountain of burgers. At least the fries haven't started talking back.$5
Entries.Wed: People think running a restaurant is easy. Try keeping everything stocked while someone asks for twelve extra pickles.$3
Entries.Thu: Hey, I love to drink Windex.$5#$b#...That's a joke. Obviously. Please never actually drink Windex.$3
Entries.Fri: Friday rush. Everybody wants fries at the same time, like they planned it.$2
Entries.Sat: Weekends are my busiest days. If I look like I'm sprinting, I probably am.$0
Entries.Sun: Sundays are slow until about noon, then it's chaos. Order something before the line shows up!$1
Entries.Mon2: Hey, @! You're becoming a regular around here.$1
Entries.Tue2: Back again? Good. I like seeing a familiar face over the counter.$1
Entries.Wed2: Fries are fresh right now, if you're asking. Which you weren't. But now you know.$5
Entries.Thu2: The secret to a good burger is not overthinking it. Okay, and a lot of cheese.$0
Entries.Fri2: Some folks order the same thing every time. I respect that. It's easy on my memory.$1
Entries.Sat2: Careful, @. If you keep this up I'm going to start learning your order by heart.$5
Entries.Sun2: Slow morning today. Nothing but me, the grill, and the sound of a very patient pickle jar.$0
Entries.Mon4: I work here every day, and I never even get a thank-you.$2#$b#...Okay, that's not fair. You say thank you, @. Thanks for that.$1
Entries.Tue4: You know what's funny? I used to dream about owning a restaurant. Nobody tells you the dream includes a lot of mopping.$5
Entries.Wed4: I came up with the Farmhand Snack Pack because folks kept leaving the farm hungry. Turns out hungry farmers are good for business.$1
Entries.Thu4: Do you ever get tired of the same routine? I love this place, but some days I wouldn't mind a nap in a sunbeam.$2
Entries.Fri4: Sometimes I wonder if anyone realizes how much work goes into keeping this place running.$2#$b#Not you, though. You get it. That's nice.$1
Entries.Sat4: Weekend crowd was rough today. Someone asked if the Coke was 'the regular kind.' It's cola. It's always the regular kind.$3
Entries.Sun4: Closing up every night takes forever. But there's a quiet moment after the last customer leaves that I kind of like.$0
Entries.Mon6: I started this place because I wanted people to leave the counter happier than they arrived. Most days, it actually works.$1
Entries.Tue6: Honestly, @, having someone around who appreciates the work makes the long shifts a lot easier.$1
Entries.Wed6: My feet hurt, my apron smells like onions, and I wouldn't trade it. Don't tell anyone I said that.$5
Entries.Thu6: I tried a new fries recipe last night. It was a disaster. We don't talk about it.$3#$b#The pickles survived though. Nothing kills those.$5
Entries.Fri6: You ever have a day where you do everything right and still the grill acts up? Yeah. That was today.$2
Entries.Sat6: Some customers leave the nicest notes. Most leave napkins. I keep both.$1
Entries.Sun6: I like it here in the valley. It's quieter than I expected, and people actually come back. That means a lot.$0
Entries.Mon8: I don't say this much, but you've made this job feel worth it, @. Thank you.$1
Entries.Tue8: Some nights I lock up and think, 'what am I even doing?' Then I think of the regulars, and I figure it out.$2#$b#You're at the top of that list, by the way.$1
Entries.Wed8: If I ever got to retire, I'd probably still hang around the grill. Old habits. Good habits, though.$5
Entries.Thu8: Running this place alone gets heavy sometimes. Having a friend who stops by makes it lighter. I mean that.$0
Entries.Fri8: I don't need a big crowd or a fancy review. I just need a few good friends and a grill that behaves. So I'm doing okay.$1
Entries.Sat8: You're about the only person who makes a Saturday rush feel fun. How do you do that?$5
Entries.Sun8: You know, I never told anyone this, but I practice my 'welcome to Bentley's' voice in the mirror. Every morning.$5#$b#Don't laugh. Okay, laugh a little.$1
Entries.spring_Tue: Spring means fresh veggies, and fresh veggies mean better burgers. Even I get excited about lettuce.$1
Entries.spring_Sat4: The Egg Festival is coming up eventually, and I always try to bring a snack. Eggs, obviously, would be too on the nose.$5
Entries.summer_Thu: It's hot enough to fry an egg on the pavement. Which, honestly, would save me some stove time.$5
Entries.summer_Fri4: Summer means cold drinks. I can barely keep the Coke stocked. It's a good problem to have.$1
Entries.fall_Wed: Fall is my favorite. Cooler days, hungrier customers, and nobody asks for ice.$1
Entries.fall_Sat4: Pumpkin everything this time of year. I'm resisting a pumpkin burger. For now.$3
Entries.winter_Mon: Nothing beats a hot basket of fries on a snowy day. That's not marketing. That's science.$1
Entries.winter_Sat4: Winter is slow. It gives me time to experiment with new menu ideas. Most of them are terrible, but a few aren't.$0
Entries.Rainy_Day_0: Rainy days mean everybody wants hot food. Drizzle is basically a customer magnet.$1
Entries.Rainy_Day_1: Rain on the roof, fries in the fryer. Honestly, not bad.$0
Entries.Rainy_Night_0: Wet shoes tracking mud across my floor. Love it. Truly. No, I don't.$3
Entries.Indoor_Day_0: Hey, @. Need a snack, or are you just here for the air conditioning?$5
Entries.Indoor_Day_1: The grill's hot, the fries are crisp, and nobody has asked me for ten extra pickles yet. Good day so far.$1
Entries.Indoor_Night_0: Almost closing time. Last order's coming up, so make it a good one!$0
Entries.Indoor_Night_1: Wiping the counter again. Somehow it's always sticky. I don't know how.$2
Entries.Outdoor_Day_0: Even when I'm off the clock, I smell like fries. It's a lifestyle.$5
Entries.Outdoor_Day_1: A walk is good for the soul. Sometimes it's good for finding new menu ideas.$1
Entries.Outdoor_Night_0: Quiet night. Just me, the stars, and a wrinkled apron.$0
Entries.spring_12: Oh, you remembered my birthday? You didn't have to... but I won't stop you if you brought me something fried.$1#$b#Seriously though, thanks for stopping by, @.$1
Entries.AcceptGift_(O){{ModId}}_Cheeseburger: You brought me a cheeseburger? Technically that's my job. But I'll admit, it's different when someone else makes it.$1
Entries.AcceptGift_(O){{ModId}}_FrenchFries: Fries! I'm surrounded by these all day and still can't say no. Thanks, @.$1
Entries.AcceptGift_(O){{ModId}}_Coke: A cold Coke. You really do know how to cheer up a tired restaurant owner.$1
Entries.AcceptGift_(O){{ModId}}_Windex: ...Is this Windex? @, this is a cleaning product, not a drink. I'll use it on the front windows.$3#$b#Fine, it's a little funny.$5
Entries.AcceptGift_(O){{ModId}}_FarmhandSnackPac: The Farmhand Snack Pack! I came up with that one. Someone else making it is the highest compliment, honestly.$1
Entries.AcceptBirthdayGift_Positive: A birthday gift I'll actually use? You're too good to me, @. Thank you.$1
Entries.AcceptBirthdayGift_Neutral: Oh, a birthday gift. Thanks, @. That's thoughtful.$0
Entries.AcceptBirthdayGift_Negative: Hmm. Well, it's the thought that counts. I think.$2
Entries.Mon10: You're one of the best things about this valley, @. I mean it. Don't let it go to your head.$1
Entries.Fri10: Closing time's a lot nicer when I know a friend might stop by before I lock up. Thanks for that.$1
